subject: Dev Bridge: RSVP reminder matrix + UTM rotation plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dev Bridge: RSVP reminder matrix + UTM rotation plan

Team —

Attached is the working rundown and the RSVP/UTM map for the June 8 "Dev Bridge: Precision Inference" webinar. Two asks to prioritize today so we can lock the sequence by EOD: 

1) Confirm reminder cadence for engineers (3-touch vs 4-touch). I recommend: initial invite, 4-day reminder, 1-day reminder, 1-hour same-day nudge.
2) Approve the UTM rotation plan in tab "UTM Map" — we need five unique tracking strings so CROs in different accounts don’t see the same link repeatedly.

Notes:
- Attachments: Webinar_Rundown_v3.pdf (agenda + speakers), RSVP_UTM_Map.xlsx (UTMs & send windows).
- External ops (Fathom) will need the final landing link by May 25 to bake into their registrant flow.

Link to live doc: https://docs.redwood.com/spaces/Events/Dev-Bridge-RSVP-Matrix
HubSpot campaign: https://app.hubspot.com/campaigns/REDWOOD-4728

Marissa — keen on your copy tweaks for the 4-day reminder. Karthik — any objections to the 1-hour nudge for low-latency attendees? Ava — can you confirm we have capacity in the invite cadence for the APAC-friendly send (we plan an alternate 9AM SGT run).

Thanks,

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dev Bridge: RSVP reminder matrix + UTM rotation plan

Stephanie —

Looks good overall. A few edits inline: 

- For the 4-day reminder copy, tighten the subject: "Code-level tricks for faster inference — RSVP" instead of "Don't miss:..." — shorter subject tends to lift opens for engineers.
- Recommend we drop the 1-hour nudge for attendees who register within 24 hours of start (noisy and low incremental). Keep it for those who registered earlier. We can segment in HubSpot by "registered_at < 24h before start".
- UTM map: I added a column for "source_subsegment" so we can tell open/dev-eng vs architect audiences.

I've attached a quick copy snippet and updated the UTM sheet: RSVP_UTM_Map.xlsx (see tab "v2_copies").

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dev Bridge: RSVP reminder matrix + UTM rotation plan

All —

Agree with Marissa on dropping the 1-hour nudge for late registrants. A couple of operational tweaks from my side: 

- Please add a column in the UTM sheet for "model_profile" (gpt-like, llama-family) so we can correlate registrant interest by model family post-event. That will be useful for post-webinar nurture routing.
- For the APAC run, set the alternate send at 09:00 SGT — Ava, do we have an extra send window in Marketo for that slot? If not, we need to coordinate with Ops.

One more ask: can we add a small A/B for the 1-day reminder subject line (technical callout vs. business outcome) limited to 10% sample? If we have UTM rotation this will be easy to track.

Karthik
Principal Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the rundown. We can support the two send windows (NA and APAC). Requested items from our side: 

- Final landing page URL and the 5 UTM variants by May 25 COB so our registration logic can map to the right tags.
- PDF for speaker bios to include on the confirmation page (we can host).
- Please confirm if you want us to suppress the 1-hour nudge for late registrants — we can implement that with a simple filter.
